Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user increases the risk of a container breakout.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument

Misconfigurations.Title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: You should add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your docker container images.

Misconfigurations.Title: ':latest' tag used
Misconfigurations.Description: Using latest is prone to errors if the image is updated.

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 bucket does not have encryption enabled
Misconfigurations.Description: S3 Bucket has no encryption enabled by default.
Misconfigurations.Message: Bucket does not have encryption enabled
